title: Tailwind.config and Vite.config
description: Study the implementation in [frontend/tailwind.config.js] and [frontend/vite.config.js]. Trace its declarations and dependencies into a caller or test. Inspect imports, declarations, and call sites in the file; filenames alone do not establish its role.

learning_objectives.text: Explain the source role and visible behavior in frontend/tailwind.config.js, frontend/vite.config.js.
Trace a declaration, setting, or documented claim to a caller, test, or implementation path.
Separate source evidence, documentation claims, and unverified runtime behavior.

completion_criteria: Submit the code-trace exercise meeting all acceptance criteria.
